name: prompts_ranked_multilingual_benchmark
description: A multilingual dataset of ranked prompts intended to evaluate and compare prompt quality and effectiveness across languages. It measures how different prompts influence model outputs using human or automatic ranking judgments, enabling cross-lingual prompt evaluation and selection. Useful for research on multilingual prompting, instruction tuning, and prompt generalization.
reputation: A specialized dataset on Hugging Face with interest from the prompt-engineering and multilingual NLP communities, but not yet a broadly established benchmark.
